evidenceIntakeCandidates.surface: Jasper IQ Brand Voice / Chat, editor, Agents
evidenceIntakeCandidates.sourceMeaning: Writing samples produce a reusable Brand Voice. A workspace default can be selected, but users can override it. The page lists Pro two voices and Business unlimited.
evidenceIntakeCandidates.limitation: A selectable or overridable voice is guidance, not an approval or policy enforcement gate; the Pro entitlement conflicts with the Jasper IQ overview.
evidenceIntakeCandidates.conflict: Jasper IQ overview says IQ is Business only.

evidenceIntakeCandidates.surface: Jasper IQ Knowledge Base / Chat, Agents, Projects
evidenceIntakeCandidates.sourceMeaning: Brand and product facts can be stored as assets; Chat or Agents may attach up to five knowledge or source items. URL content may be cached up to two days. This page lists Pro five assets and Business unlimited.
evidenceIntakeCandidates.limitation: Knowledge retrieval does not verify generated facts; Pro entitlement conflicts with the Jasper IQ overview.
evidenceIntakeCandidates.conflict: Jasper IQ overview says IQ is Business only.

evidenceIntakeCandidates.sourceMeaning: IQ includes Brand Voice, Knowledge Base, Style Guide and Product IQ; its availability section says Business plans.
evidenceIntakeCandidates.limitation: Do not use this overview to erase the conflicting Pro allowances on the individual Brand Voice and Knowledge pages; obtain current account or contract entitlement before verification.
evidenceIntakeCandidates.conflict: Individual feature pages list Pro allowances.

evidenceIntakeCandidates.surface: Jasper Business Style Guide / Chat, Apps, Canvas, Public API
evidenceIntakeCandidates.sourceMeaning: Terminology and style rules are applied during generation; one guide is active at a time; workspace and Canvas project defaults are supported. Style Guide is Business only.
evidenceIntakeCandidates.limitation: Automatic document extraction is beta and requires review. Generated text still needs human brand, policy and factual approval.
evidenceIntakeCandidates.conflict: This page says only Admins/Managers edit guides, while Permission Settings describes a toggle that may allow anyone to edit; target workspace behavior needs inspection.

evidenceIntakeCandidates.surface: Jasper Business Workspace Settings / permission toggles
evidenceIntakeCandidates.sourceMeaning: Admins may restrict who creates or edits Brand Voice, Knowledge and Style Guide; all users can still view or use allowed assets.
evidenceIntakeCandidates.limitation: Asset editing controls are not evidence of a mandatory marketing-copy approval state.
evidenceIntakeCandidates.conflict: When the Style Guide toggle is off, this page says anyone may edit; the Style Guide page says only Admins/Managers can edit.

evidenceIntakeCandidates.surface: Jasper Canvas/Grid asset download and storage integrations
evidenceIntakeCandidates.sourceMeaning: Local download offers DOCX, PDF, TXT and Markdown; Drive, SharePoint and Box export integrations require admin enablement.
evidenceIntakeCandidates.limitation: Export is delivery to storage or file, not proof that content passed brand approval or was published to a CMS.

evidenceIntakeCandidates.sourceMeaning: Pro, Plus, Business and Enterprise can configure on-brand/off-brand tones; writers receive feedback as they write.
evidenceIntakeCandidates.limitation: Feedback is advisory and can be scoped to selected websites; it is not a mandatory approval or proof that AI first drafts inherit brand settings.

evidenceIntakeCandidates.sourceMeaning: Custom terminology, spelling and formatting rules produce suggestions. Pro supports one set; Business supports up to 50; group and organization assignment and suggestion statistics are documented.
evidenceIntakeCandidates.limitation: Suggestions can be accepted or dismissed; website scope and active setting affect coverage. The exact Plus/Enterprise quantity remains unknown.

evidenceIntakeCandidates.surface: Grammarly Business marketing page / style guide and generative AI
evidenceIntakeCandidates.sourceMeaning: The page describes AI drafting and brand guidance and confirms style guide use in browser extension and desktop app, not mobile.
evidenceIntakeCandidates.limitation: Marketing descriptions do not directly establish that a given AI draft automatically applies assigned organization tones/rules. Do not use this page for drafting.support or drafting.availability.

evidenceIntakeCandidates.sourceMeaning: Editor documents can be downloaded; uploaded DOCX remains DOCX on download, while uploaded TXT exports as DOCX.
evidenceIntakeCandidates.limitation: This is local document delivery, not a CMS/API or approval workflow.

evidenceIntakeCandidates.sourceMeaning: Project knowledge and instructions are reused across chats within a project; Free accounts can create five projects; Team/Enterprise offer visibility controls.
evidenceIntakeCandidates.limitation: This is reusable context and prompt instruction, not a dedicated Brand Voice, enforceable style rule set or approval workflow; no Tool Capability link proposed.

evidenceIntakeCandidates.sourceMeaning: Owners can set organization-wide instructions; the page says instruction priority is prompt-level, may vary on contradictory inputs, and changes can take up to one hour.
evidenceIntakeCandidates.limitation: Prompt priority is not deterministic brand policy enforcement, approval or a dedicated Brand Voice entitlement; no Tool Capability link proposed.

evidenceIntakeCandidates.sourceMeaning: Docs made from templates can export to Word, PDF, Markdown and Google Docs.
evidenceIntakeCandidates.limitation: Document templates and export show a delivery surface only; they do not establish brand-guided generation or governance.
